# Rachel Kirmitsaki

> A working notebook from Rachel Kirmitsaki on product, people, technology and the questions that shape the work.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Field notes, longer pieces on product and people, and the places the observations came from.
- [The Work](/the-work): Chapters from a career across cybersecurity, financial markets and academic research.
- [Across Product](/systems-and-people): Longer pieces on product direction, teams, systems, customers and technology.
- [Field Notes](/field-notes): Short notes from meetings, tools, decisions and the odd thing that keeps happening.
- [About](/about): How a beige box on a designated desk turned into a career spent building little worlds inside a screen.
